title: Projects and basic Tasks: first vertical slice
description:
Deliver the approved first vertical slice: create and select a Project, create a default Task in a URL-backed modal, and show that Task in the selected Project direct list.

Source design: docs/specs/2026-07-18-projects-basic-tasks-first-slice-design.md.

Execution plan: docs/archive/plans/2026-07-18-projects-basic-tasks-first-slice.md.

## Success Criteria

- A user can create and select a Project for an existing local directory.
- A user can create a default Pending/None Task from a URL-backed modal.
- The selected Project direct list contains only its Tasks.
- Unknown Project URLs preserve the working sidebar.
- mix precommit and the browser acceptance smoke test pass.
close_reason: All five first-increment tasks completed, task-reviewed, whole-slice reviewed, and verified by automated and browser acceptance checks.

title: Task editing and human-controlled lifecycle controls
description: Finish the remaining Projects and basic Tasks roadmap scope: edit persisted Task fields and let a person explicitly change lifecycle state from the existing list-first Project context. Keep the later full Task-detail surface, relationships, checklists, deletion, Lists, and Agent Sessions out of this increment.
acceptance_criteria:
- Users can edit title, description, priority, and optional local due date-time.
- Users can explicitly select every fixed Task lifecycle value without automatic transitions or hard gates.
- Persisted status and priority render in the direct Task list.
- Unknown and cross-Project Task URLs recover without exposing or mutating another Project's Task.
- Focused context, LiveView, browser, and mix precommit verification pass.
- Roadmap and handoff accurately report the resulting state.
close_reason: All five child tasks are closed after the final whole-branch corrections; focused suites, 43-test mix precommit, long-delay Orca submission acceptance, PostgreSQL invariant tests, architecture checks, and documentation gates are fresh and green.

title: Add Task lookup and update boundary
description: Add the Project-scoped Task lookup and update APIs required by the approved editing design. Preserve ownership in application code and cover editable fields and every fixed lifecycle value with focused context tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- Task lookup accepts a Project and returns nil for invalid, missing, or differently owned Task IDs.
- Task updates persist title, description, priority, status, and optional local due date-time.
- Project ownership cannot be changed through update attributes.
- Existing validation and database constraints remain effective.
- Focused context tests cover ownership isolation, invalid input, persisted fields, and lifecycle values.
close_reason: Implemented and independently reviewed the Project-scoped Task lookup/update boundary, fixed enum accessors, ownership isolation, and focused context coverage in commits 49605e3 and 18eac05.

title: Add URL-backed Task editing flow
description: Implement the approved URL-backed Task edit surface over the selected Project direct list. Reuse project-owned form and modal foundations where appropriate, preserve the list on open/cancel/error, and re-stream the Task after a successful update.
acceptance_criteria:
- A selected Project Task opens an edit surface represented in the URL over the preserved direct list.
- Title, description, priority, and optional local due date-time are editable.
- Cancel returns to the selected Project URL without changing the Task.
- Invalid input stays in the edit surface with inline errors.
- Saving updates only the selected Project Task, closes the edit surface, and refreshes its streamed row.
- Unknown and cross-Project Task IDs show a recoverable state without exposing or mutating another Project's Task.
- Focused LiveView tests cover open, cancel, validation, save, and URL recovery.
close_reason: Implemented and independently reviewed the canonical URL-backed Task modal, scoped lookup/recovery, immediate targeted autosave, validation, and stream-safe row refresh through commit 043cffe; approved design supersedes the issue's earlier explicit-save wording.

title: Add human Task lifecycle controls
description: Expose explicit human-controlled Task status changes in the location chosen by the approved design and render persisted status and priority values in the direct Task list. Do not introduce automatic transitions, hard lifecycle gates, or relationship-dependent Done warnings.
acceptance_criteria:
- A person can select Icebox, Pending, In Progress, In Review, Done, or Will Not Do.
- Every status change is explicit and persisted; no application event changes status automatically.
- Human transitions are not hard-gated.
- Task rows render their persisted status and priority rather than fixed Pending/None labels.
- Updated rows are re-streamed without losing the selected Project context.
- Focused tests cover every lifecycle value and dynamic row rendering.
close_reason: Implemented and independently reviewed explicit selection of every Task lifecycle value plus persisted status/priority row rendering and stream refresh through commit 043cffe; no automatic transitions or hard gates added.

title: Expand explicit Task creation form
description: Implement the approved full Task creation form design. Reuse the complete editing field set for explicit creation, gate Create task on server-side form validity, preserve trusted Project ownership, keep submission-time errors in the modal with the complete draft, and leave editing autosave unchanged.
acceptance_criteria:
- Creation exposes title, description, status, priority, and optional due date-time through the shared Task form.
- Create task stays disabled until the latest server-validated creation draft is valid.
- Project ownership is assigned from the selected trusted Project and cannot be replaced by parameters.
- Successful creation persists every submitted field, updates the Task stream, closes the modal, and returns to the Project URL.
- Rejected direct submissions preserve the complete draft and show available inline errors.
- Existing Task editing autosave behavior remains unchanged.
- Focused context, LiveView, autosave, and mix precommit verification pass.
notes: Implemented in commits 2f5b158, 49356ae, and 76725f8 on full-task-creation-form. Task 3 verification completed on 2026-08-03; see the verification comment for fresh suite and review evidence. No handoff remains active.
close_reason: Implemented and verified the complete Task creation form: shared five-field controls, server-validity gating, trusted Project ownership, complete persistence, cancellation and rejected-draft preservation, with editing autosave unchanged.

title: Install Git in Alpine Elixir CI
description: GitHub Actions run 31395719161 job 93478006283 fails at mix deps.get because the pinned HexPM Alpine image has no git executable, while mix.exs fetches heroicons and daisyui from GitHub. Add the minimal Alpine git package installation before dependency resolution, preserve the pinned toolchain and other workflow behavior, and verify the exact failing path.
close_reason: Fixed the confirmed Alpine CI runtime prerequisites for dependency resolution and database-backed tests.

comments.author: jakub
comments.text: Second confirmed CI boundary: after installing Git, an isolated Alpine job simulation reached mix test and failed because config/test.exs connects to localhost:5432 while the workflow has no PostgreSQL service. GitHub's documented container-job pattern uses a postgres service label plus POSTGRES_HOST=postgres. The fix must include that service and retain localhost as the local default.
